LI.FI: The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive

title: Intent-based execution lets agents express outcomes while professional solvers handle routing and settlement
content:
Rather than instructing agents on technical routing, the agentic payment system operates on **intent principles**: agents express desired outcomes (e.g., "Pay 50 USDC to this Solana address from my Arbitrum balance") while professional solvers handle cross-chain routing and settlement.

**Data point:** LI.FI's routing layer has handled more than **$80 billion in lifetime transfer volume across 100 million transfers**. Cross-chain settlement at scale remains one of the three open challenges, addressed by LI.FI's Solver Network and the Open Intents Framework.

**Pattern:** declarative outcomes + competitive fulfillment — the same separation of *what* from *how* that makes agents composable at the tool layer, applied to money movement.

Source: LI.FI, "The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive" (https://li.fi/knowledge-hub/the-agentic-economy-%E2%80%94-a-deep-dive).
